value.title: Workstream 007: starting and stopping a seat in a role

sections.name: goal
sections.value: One command starts a registered seat that has already been told what it needs, and any seat can suggest a missing one.

value.title: Launch settings and parameters on a role
value.done_when: A role records harness, model, effort and its parameters, and a missing required parameter is refused by name.

value.title: The assembled first turn
value.done_when: `pij directory show <role> --first-turn` prints the turn with the source of each part, including a focus or packet the prime added.

value.title: Spawn with a role named
value.done_when: One spawn with `--as role:<id>` launches, assigns and briefs a seat for a templated or a dynamic role; a spawn without it works as before and prints how to do it now; the spawn counter moves by one spawn.

value.title: Seats with no role in the view
value.done_when: A live seat holding no role appears in `pij directory` with the line that fixes it.

value.title: Anyone creates a seat and the prime is told; suggest when unsure
value.done_when: A seat created by a non-prime is recorded with its creator and the prime gets one note; `pij directory suggest` records a suggestion the prime's view lists and answers.

value.title: Close that stops the seat
value.done_when: `pij close <seat> --stop` takes a ready holder down by its recorded process, leaves a silent or memoryless one running and tells the prime, and never wakes a cold one.

value.change: Owner moved from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001, which runs the build of PRDs 006, 007, 008 and 010.
Each step names the blueprint 005 component it builds and its plan (240 to 245).
